name: Salient Subset Construction via Cumulative Histograms
definition: A technique to build representative voxel subsets ($\Gamma$ and $\Lambda$) by thresholding volume quantities using cumulative histograms, allowing control over the percentage of voxels included.
summary: Salient Subset Construction via Cumulative Histograms selects representative sparse voxel subsets for volume rendering by using histogram-based thresholding, distinguishing itself from methods that define salience via second-order directional derivatives.
